_doc: Dialogue portraits for the two Ghostlight Express speakers with no photoreal portrait (the conductor's understudy, Mrs. Calloway). Three seeds each for Ashwin to pick; the pick is copied to art/portraits/<id>.png, then tools/art/build_portrait_busts.py --only <id>. Queued at normal priority (the image server may be paused): photoreal.py tools/art/specs/portraits_act1_photoreal.json

conductor_understudy_a.prompt: Head-and-shoulders portrait of a small anthropomorphic green frog dressed as a railway conductor's understudy, facing the viewer: a navy-blue conductor's cap a size too small with a red band and a little brass badge, a navy double-breasted uniform jacket with brass buttons, red piping and gold cuff stripes, a crisp white collar and dark tie. Big round golden eyes, a wide self-important mouth set in a puffed-up pout, glossy damp skin with darker green spots. He stands inside a dim 1920s passenger railcar at night, brass sconces and worn velvet seats blurred behind him, cold moonlight through the window and a lantern glow on his face.

mrs_calloway_a.prompt: Head-and-shoulders portrait of the ghost of an elderly 1920s widow, facing the viewer with a patient, wistful half-smile: silver hair in a neat finger-waved bob, a long string of pearls over a modest drop-waist dress of faded taupe silk with short puffed sleeves, pale translucent grey-blue skin with a faint ghostly glow, tired kind eyes. She sits at a dining-car table set for two with an empty chair across from her, white linen and old silver, a candle flickering, the dark railcar windows behind her, cold moonlight and a soft ghostly green rim light.
